stem.text: Which compound is a secondary alcohol that can be dehydrated to form an alkene with $M_\text{r} = 70$?

A.alt: Skeletal formula of an alcohol with the OH group drawn below a branched carbon (option A)

B.alt: Skeletal formula of a branched alcohol with the OH group drawn below an internal carbon (option B)

C.alt: Skeletal formula of an alcohol with the OH group drawn below an internal carbon of a straight chain (option C)

D.alt: Skeletal formula of cyclopentanol: a five-membered carbocyclic ring carrying an OH group
